title: The Eiffel Tower Changes Height ☀️ #Shorts
script: The Eiffel Tower can become slightly taller in hot weather. Metal expands as its temperature rises, so the iron structure can gain several centimeters during warm conditions. Uneven heating from sunlight can also make the tower shift slightly away from the Sun. Engineers understand thermal expansion and design large structures to tolerate movement like this. Even famous landmarks are constantly responding to physics. Follow for more engineering facts.

scenes.sub: Warm weather can make it taller.
